answer.explanation: The live UploaderFunction configuration was modified at 19:57:11Z, two seconds before the window opens. It now has MemorySize 128 MB and Timeout 3 s, while the committed SAM template specifies 256 MB and 30 s. The other three functions match the template. Logs confirm the change: REPORT lines from 19:57:16 onward show Memory Size 128 MB, cold-start Init Durations of about 465 ms, and durations up to 708 ms, against roughly 100 ms and 256 MB before the change. The Timeout of 3 s is tight for these cold starts. No commit in the recent history touches the uploader's memory or timeout, so the change was made outside the IaC pipeline. The template itself is correct, so IAC is not the cause.
